title: •IT-O (Eyetee-Oh)
caption: •IT-0 (Eyetee-Oh) (V)
lore: Floating prisoner interrogation droid. Uses probes and needles to dispense truth drugs and perform ‘surgery.’ Sensors determine subject’s pain threshold and truthfulness.
game_text: Wherever you have a captive, your Force drains are +2. Once per game, may ▼ Hypo. Immune to Restraining Bolt and attrition < 3.
